title: Fault-Tolerant Entry-Point Plugin Loader
instructions: In `plugins.py` implement `load_plugins` and `discover`. Load entry points in name order, isolate every plugin failure (including `SystemExit` from import-time `sys.exit()`, but never `KeyboardInterrupt`), validate the loaded object, reject duplicate names, and return a `LoadReport`. `LoadReport` is already declared.

evidence.label: Loads valid plugins and reports them in name order
A missing module or attribute is recorded without stopping other plugins
Failed validation is recorded as a TypeError mentioning the entry-point value
Duplicate names are rejected, with neither entry loaded
discover returns a LoadReport for an installed group such as console_scripts
An unknown group yields an empty report
A plugin calling sys.exit() at import is recorded as a failure
Import-time exceptions are recorded; three entries with one name still fail as duplicates
discover queries entry_points(group=...) and applies the validator
